description: Give a project its own statuses (board columns), e.g. for a shop: New order, Paid, Packing, Shipped, Delivered, Returned. Each status is one of 6 kinds (backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, done, canceled): the kind decides what counts as open, done or canceled. The list REPLACES the current one in this order; keep the id of a status you keep (see get_project -> statuses); issues of a removed status move to the first status of the same kind, else to the first status. An empty list goes back to the 6 base statuses.

statuses.description: the whole new list of columns in board order; an empty list = the 6 standard statuses

icon.description: one emoji shown for this status instead of the icon of its kind

name: set_project_statuses
